title: Monster Truck Destruction
description:
DRIVE, DESTROY, AND CREATE YOUR WAY TO GLORY!

The crowd is louder than ever—and they want total destruction. Monster Truck Destruction returns with massive new features and improvements that take the chaos to the next level!

 

BUILD THE MAYHEM

Jump into the all-new Level Editor mode and unleash your creativity using 700+ props. You can share your creations and challenge yourself with community-created maps.

 

A MONSTER LINEUP

Expand your garage with 120 new trucks, and browse them all in the new Truck Collection menu. From Bigfoot trucks to customized trucks, everything is within your grasp!

REALISTIC TRUCKIN’, REAL DESTRUCTION

Experience improved physics where trucks bounce, drift, and grip like never before. Smash through obstacles with a dynamic damage system that makes every crash feel powerful and satisfying.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TRUCK 

Upgrade and personalize your trucks with Customization Upgrades. Players can modify truck part colors or adding flags at rear, to having neon lights or adjusting truck suspension. Make your monster truck look unique!

NEW GAME MODES 

Take on the new game modes: 

- Floor is Lava: Reach the finish line on time without falling through the lava.

- Multiplayer: Multiplayer lobbies! Players can now hop on with their friends and prove who's the best driver of them all!

Key Features• Thrilling and destructive monster truck gameplay.

• Realistic truck physics and dynamic damage system.

• 120+ monster trucks to choose from with a full Truck Collection system.

• Level Editor with 700+ props and playable community maps.

• Upgrade your trucks as your competition gets harder.

• Multiple game modes: Freestyle, Drag, Side by Side, Championships, Multiplayer, and Floor is Lava.

• Compete on real life tracks as created by the Monster X Tour crew.

• Customization Upgrades to personalize your trucks with flags, neon lights, part color modifications.
description_short: Can you handle 1600HP of pure monster truck chaos? Crush cars, soar through massive jumps, and build your own tracks in Monster Truck Destruction—now bigger than ever with new trucks, modes, and multiplayer mayhem!
